g.text: Immerse CdS/ZnO arrays in the stated cadmium acetate dihydrate, sodium selenosulfate
and ammonium hydroxide bath in 20 mL deionized water for 3 h at 95 °C. Total final
bath volume, stirring, atmosphere and bath heater are not reported.
Complete 10 total SILAR cycles output; CdSe chemical bath deposition solution
Deposit CdSe by chemical bath output
Solid substrate enters or contacts liquid; container is symbolic.
Conceptual operation diagram. Vessel type, dimensions, fill level and physical vessel continuity are not
inferred; the arrows are action cues, not measured apparatus geometry.
SOURCE: Main PDF p.2 (printed 269), Experimental Section, Fabrication of CdSe/CdS/ZnO Heterojunction Nanowire
